dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave spline along the trailing edge from the posterior insertion point to the rounded apex.

dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.
